title: Glass Shelf With Integrated Towel Bar - 16-Inch - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear vanity clutter and keep a towel right where you need it. This wall-mounted glass shelf combines a 16-inch tempered glass ledge with an integrated towel bar for everyday bathroom organization.

  • Gain instant storage above the sink with a 16 x 5-inch tempered, beveled-edge glass shelf.
  • Keep towels within reach thanks to the integrated towel bar beneath the shelf.
  • Choose enduring hardware crafted from solid brass for strength and stability.
  • Create a coordinated look as part of the Waverly Place collection—ideal for matching Waverly Place accessories and other transitional bath accessories.
  • Made for long-term use with designer finishes that provide corrosion-free and rust-free performance.

Specs & Installation

  • Glass shelf dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
  • Glass thickness: 3/8 in (0.38 in)
  • Overall projection: 5 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Mounting: wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
